article.story: LAWRENCEVILLE, N.J. -- — Abdou Khadre Kebe scored 15 points and grabbed 10 rebounds as Mount St. Mary's beat Rider 65-55 on Friday night. Trey Deveaux scored 12 points and Xavier Lipscomb finished with 11 points for the Mountaineers (12-15, 8-8 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Zion Cruz finished with 22 points and two steals for the Broncs (3-21, 2-13). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
